description: Walkable Distance to Public Transit is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Public Health. This table contains data on the percent of population residing within ½ mile of a major transit stop for four California regions and the counties, cities/towns, and census tracts within the regions. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Public Health. Its tags are access to high quality public transit, california department of public health, hci, healthy community indicator, public transportation. It offers 4 resource(s) in PDF, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
